expectation: Membrane rings on memory/activated T cells (a subset of CD3+ cells) and some myeloid cells. Moderately common in tumour immune infiltrates: clustered in immune-rich stroma or aggregates, with scattered single cells in tumour nests.
observed: A: yellow signal varies between ROIs, with dense patchy immune-rich areas and sparse ones. B/C: scattered small membrane-ringed cells in stroma, absent from nuclear-dense nests. D: dense ringed cells. E: CD45RO lies on a large subset of CD3 cells (white in merge); CD3-negative holes are dark in both.
why: Membrane-ringed cells cluster in immune-rich regions and overlap a subset of CD3+ T cells, with dark CD3-negative areas, as the marker graph expects.
notes: Clear membrane staining of clustered lymphoid cells that sit on CD3+ cells in row E; tumour-nest regions stay dark. Specific CD45RO population.
